text: The Nominating Panel – Committee of Adjustment will conduct interviews and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment to the Etobicoke York panel of the Committee of Adjustment.

The Nominating Panel - Committee of Adjustment: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment: Candidate COA1-354 Candidate COA2-142 Candidate COA2-160 Candidate COA2-180 Candidate COA2-183 Candidate COA2-185 Candidate COA2-188 Candidate COA2-191 2. Recommended that 20 minutes be allotted for each interview. 3. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (February 10, 2020) remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment.
